question: How do potential climatic niches of native-screened larval host plants shift between 0BP and 21ka, and for which of their 641 associated insects could a spatially explicit resource-connectivity model become evaluable?

inputs.study_region: all 369 present-day WCVP geographic TDWG L3 areas, source-fixed 6373 global native land representative climate points

train.background_rule: source-pinned 0.5 degree WCVP support-point terrestrial proxy inside that plant's current native L3 regions, sampling without replacement up to 1000 deterministic SHA256 priority; not pseudo-absences or complete accessible area
train.model: L2-penalized binomial presence/native-area-background classifier; C=0.3; balanced 1:1 class weights; fixed solver liblinear, max_iter=1000
train.validation: one deterministic spatial-block holdout of 2 degree cells: blocks assigned sorted deterministically in cyclic quintiles; test only if holdout >=5 presences and >=5 background and training at least 20 on both sides; report AUC only as a limited internal bias-risk diagnostic
train.global_climate_scaling: 0BP global 6343 valid land representative climates, then same mean/SD applies at 21ka

project.projection_sites: 6343 source-pinned support points across 369 present WCVP region polygons, not all 1 km raster cells
project.response: relative pseudo-presence logit score; not true plant occupancy probability
project.climatic_suitability_threshold: 10th percentile of 0BP fitted native plant presence scores; sensitivity 5th and 15th percentile
project.nonanalog_flag: LGM climate any standardized predictor more than 5% of a modern native-background+presence observed range outside those ranges; report and exclude from 'supported' summary
species_level_measures: 0BP climatic suitable fraction on all global support points
LGM climatic suitable fraction on the same sites
modern model spatial test AUC if valid
individual species N and known native regions

bounds: The LGM outputs indicate potential climatic suitability under 21ka CHELSA, never observed LGM plant occupancy
Native current TDWG level3 remains coarse and may be incorrect for cultivated or taxonomically complex hosts
Target-group iNaturalist observational effort is nonrandom; 0BP background points are opportunistically selected geographic proxy, not actual absences
Model does not include dispersal, glaciation barriers, LGM shoreline, competition, host-fidelity, population genetics or migration
No recalibration after seeing v01 LGM suitability results, no genetic response opened
Full 641 species remain in the resource support universe even if some plants do not pass modelling qualifications
Do not merge prior negative v05 biological host-identity results or reinterpret climate analogues as genetic evidence
